args.text: I see a red popcorn machine inside a circle, a coin counter at 0, back/sound/restart buttons at top, and a bottom card with a greyed bucket, a 24-coin price and an up arrow. The machine has a pointing finger icon on its front, so I think tapping the machine makes popcorn. The bottom card looks like an upgrade (bucket?) costing 24 coins, greyed out because I have 0. I'll tap the machine first.
One tap gave 1 coin, the hint circle vanished. A thin yellow bar appeared at the bottom of the upgrade card - probably progress toward 24. Let me tap a bunch more.
6 coins after 6 taps. The bucket icon is filling with gold from the bottom and the yellow bar grows - nice wordless progress. I wonder if holding the finger down pops faster. Trying a 3 second hold.
Holding only gave 1 coin (machine squished a bit). So it's tap-tap-tap. Going to tap it a lot to reach 24 and see what the bucket does.
16 coins. The whole card is filling with yellow like a liquid level - I like that, I can see I'm about two thirds there. No passive income so far, it's purely tapping. 8 more.
24 coins! The card lit up bright yellow, the bucket turned dark brown and the arrow turned red - clearly 'you can buy this now'. Tapping the card.

Bought it! The machine grew bigger and got a striped awning with bunting - looks fancier. Coins reset to 0, next card is a cart with wheels for 41. A popcorn kernel is lying on the floor to the left. Does a tap give more now? Let me tap and see.
One tap = 2 coins now, so the upgrade doubled my tap. The floor kernel is gone. Quick check: does anything happen if I just wait?

Nothing passive - still 2 after waiting, and the soft circle came back around the machine like a 'tap me' reminder when idle. OK, tapping toward the 41-coin cart. I'll try the glass kettle part too, in case it's different.
24 of 41, steady 2 per tap, anywhere on the machine works. I'm not seeing popcorn fly out in my screenshots, so the tap feels a bit invisible except for the number ticking. 9 more taps to the cart.
That should be 42 coins - buying the wheeled cart now.

Wow - now it's a cart on wheels and there was a burst of golden popcorn confetti all around it. That felt like a real reward! Leftover 1 coin, next upgrade 69 (looks like a bigger stand). Let me see what a tap gives now.
Now +3 per tap (a faint +3 floated up) and popcorn pieces bounce out. NEW: a yellow clock badge saying 3:00 appeared under my coins. Is it a countdown? A round timer? Tapping more to see if it moves.

13 coins. The clock badge went UP from 3:00 to 3:11 - so it's not a countdown, it seems to be how long I've been playing. Not sure why it only showed up after the cart. Still curious what the 69 stand looks like.
